verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only navigation titles for Washington SOS filing services and no statement listing the account-creation, credential, or identity-proofing steps a founder must complete before filing. The DOR snippets about an account used for taxes and an online application system come from a separate agency's business-licensing flow and only hint that an account exists. They do not set out the prerequisite steps up front, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
